scope.summary: Implement the media-embed board object as StudioLayer (placed_asset/embed kinds): images, video/GIF media, external iframe embeds, and unfurled link-preview cards. Reuses the placed-asset primitive. Command-addressable, promotion-gated, undoable; embed network access is consent-gated.
expected_tests: live: embed image + video + link-preview card
negative: iframe/link embed network access is consent-gated (no ambient egress)
argus: media embed tool by author_id

risk_if_missed: No media embeds, or ambient network egress on embeds.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-WB-004] Studio MUST provide the deduped whiteboard object set below as first-class `StudioLayer` kinds addressable by the typed command contract (14.14) and, where noted, reusing existing Studio primitives rather than reinventing them. Connectors are "smart": they attach to object anchor magnets and auto-reroute as endpoints move. | Board object | Behavior | Reused / backing primitive | |---|---|---| | Sticky note | Auto-sizing text card with color options and optional author-name attribution | `StudioLayer` (sticky kind) + `StudioTextStory` | | Shape with text | Diagram shape (rectangle, ellipse, diamond, and related) carrying inline editable text, resizing around it, as a flowchart node | `StudioVectorPath` + `StudioTextStory` | | Smart connector | Line attaching to object anchor magnets, auto-rerouting on move, with straight/elbow styles, arrowheads, and inline labels | `StudioVectorPath` (connector kind) | | Stamp / emote | Droppable stamp objects (dots, stars, hearts, plus-ones with attribution) and transient emote animations | `StudioLayer` (stamp kind) + collaboration transient (14.17) | | Table | Cell grid with add/remove rows and columns, cell text, and cell fills for lightweight matrices | `StudioLayer` (table kind) | | Mind map | Node tree that branches via keyboard/handle with automatic layout and sibling rebalancing | `StudioLayer` (mindmap kind) + connectors | | Section | Named container grouping board content, collapsible/expandable, usable as a navigation and voting target | `StudioLayer` (section kind) | | Media embed | Images, video/GIF media, external iframe embeds, and unfurled link-preview cards | `StudioLayer` (placed_asset / embed kinds) | | Code block | Syntax-highlighted code snippet with language selection | `StudioLayer` (code kind) + `StudioTextStory` | | Washi tape | Patterned decorative tape strips for attaching or decorating content | `StudioLayer` (decoration kind) + `StudioPattern` | | Drawing (marker/highlighter) | Freehand marker and highlighter ink strokes tuned for whiteboarding rather than precision vector illustration | `StudioVectorPath` (ink kind) | ### 3. Templates and widgets

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
